name: page-guide-alias-precedence
goal: Preserve canonical topic and plural precedence when adding page help aliases; guard the shared topic resolver through its standardized lookup matrix

evidence: Unreleased alias change 242d0cec sends plural pages directly to view even when a canonical page topic exists; the previous generic plural resolver preferred the canonical topic.
The standard guide lookup scenario checked aliases only against the built-in catalog. Extend its reusable matrix with canonical/alias collisions, plural forms and case normalization.
Checkpoint 9284d7f7 on e510943a reproduces the canonical-topic collision in the standard guide lookup matrix.
Keep canonical candidates before the view fallback; require collision and normalization coverage before extending an alias resolver.
Preserve page before view and add the reusable alias review gate to repository agent instructions; keep the standard lookup test unchanged.
Checkpoint 22d74c09 at ce231cafa passes the same frozen guide test and retains fresh behavior timing and worker memory.
After repair, independent clean-snapshot capture 92a2340e reruns e510943a and fails the unchanged guard; restored ce231cafa passes in 22d74c09.
